retrievalProfile.description: A classic mid-century music layout featuring a candid portrait with tiered typography and horizontal rule dividers.
triggerTerms: vintage portrait with tiered serif text

recipe.visualDefinition: A candid, medium-close-up portrait of a man in a fedora and suit, positioned against a neutral studio background. The top third of the frame is dedicated to a structured typographic stack featuring a large serif name, a secondary script-like or slab-serif title in a contrasting color, and smaller credits separated by thin horizontal lines.
coreVisualRelationships: Text-heavy top third balanced by a large-scale subject in the bottom two-thirds
Horizontal rules framing the secondary credits to create a 'shelf' effect
Color coordination between the secondary text and the cool tones of the background
Subject's gaze directed away from the camera to create a candid, approachable feel
coreInvariants: Tiered hierarchy of three distinct font sizes

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the lower 70% of the frame, slightly off-center to the right, in a medium-close-up profile view.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and fedora act as the primary anchor, with the bold teal title serving as the secondary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large top name, drop to the teal title, then follow the subject's gaze toward the right edge of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the upper background allows for clear legibility of the multi-line text block.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white/cream background and neutral grey-beige studio tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for the primary name and the subject's suit/hat.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted teal or cyan for the secondary title text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the dark clothing and light background.

letterConstructionRules: Primary name uses a tall, high-contrast serif with vertical stress
Secondary title uses a lower-contrast, slightly rounded slab-serif or heavy transitional serif
Credits use a small, wide-set serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: None; relies on standard mid-century metal type proportions
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrasting a high-contrast black serif with a low-contrast colored slab-serif for visual separation.
graphicDevices: Rounded corner frame for the main image

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast serif used for the primary name.
Captures the sturdy, mid-century feel of the secondary title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a candid 1950s-style portrait of a man in a dark suit and fedora, laughing and looking to the side. The background should be a neutral, light-colored studio wall with soft shadows and a few vertical poles visible. Frame the image with a thin black line and rounded corners.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three levels of text at the top. Level 1: Large black serif name. Level 2: Medium teal slab-serif title. Level 3: Small black serif credits between two thin horizontal lines. Center all text.

verificationChecks: Is the primary name in a high-contrast serif?
Are there horizontal rules framing the bottom credit line?
Is the subject wearing a fedora and looking away from the camera?

adjustableVariables: Accent color (teal can be swapped for red or gold)
postGenerationChecks: Check for three distinct text sizes
Ensure horizontal rules are perfectly straight
Verify the teal color is muted, not neon
Confirm the subject is in a classic 1950s suit/hat
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a candid mid-century portrait with a top-weighted, three-tier serif typographic stack separated by horizontal rules.
